title: Applied AI Engineer | Forward Deployed Engineer
bioParagraphs: I'm an Applied AI Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with 5 years in software engineering — the last 2+ forward-deployed — building production Generative AI and full-stack applications end to end. I embed with sales, business and data teams to ship enterprise AI products from proof-of-concept through deployment, evaluation and iteration, hardening the LLM workflows and the Kubernetes and serverless AWS platforms underneath them. Strong across agentic AI, MCP, RAG and LLM evaluation.

connect.text: Based in Hyderabad, India — open to relocation (Netherlands, Japan) and global remote. Always happy to talk AI products, agent platforms, or FDE roles.
